subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this provider-backed WeChat hot-reload change show a redacted live A+B QR-login run before merge, or may gateway regression coverage be accepted as the merge proof for this exact head?
rationale: The remaining gap is not a mechanical repair: the contributor has explicitly stated that their environment cannot run a real WeChat provider session, while the generic gateway changes affect lifecycle behavior beyond the mocked tests.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a real A+B QR-login reload shows that adding account B leaves account A online, with private values redacted.

options.title: Accept gateway proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider proof and review the exact head using the focused lifecycle regressions plus required CI as sufficient evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a real A+B QR-login reload shows that adding account B leaves account A online, with private values redacted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the adjacent account-reload lifecycle makes this the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate available from the supplied history.
